title: Oleiferasaponin C                     <sub>6</sub>                     from the seeds of Camellia oleifera Abel.: a novel compound inhibits proliferation through inducing cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis on human cancer cell lines in vitro
abstract: Oleiferasaponin C                     6                     was isolated from                     Camellia oleifera                     Abel. and inhibits proliferation through inducing cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis on cancer cell lines                     in vitro                     .
